itens.titulo: BB Seguridade (BBSE3) substitui Petrobras (PETR4) na carteira de dividendos da Terra; veja a seleção de outubro
itens.descricao: BB Seguridade (BBSE3) substitui Petrobras (PETR4) na carteira de dividendos da Terra; veja a seleção de outubro moneytimes.com.br
itens.texto:
BB Seguridade (BBSE3) substitui Petrobras (PETR4) na carteira de dividendos da Terra; veja a seleção de outubro
A Terra Investimentos fez apenas uma alteração na sua carteira recomendada de dividendos para outubro. A casa retirou Petrobras (PETR4) e incluiu BB Seguridade (BBSE3) no portfólio. Com a mudança, a carteira passa a ser composta por Itaúsa (ITSA4), Bradespar (BRAP4), Engie Brasil (EGIE3) e Cemig (CMIG4).
A seleção, segundo a Terra, busca empresas com múltiplos atrativos, perspectivas de crescimento por meio da distribuição de dividendos, sólido balanço financeiro, boa geração de caixa e elevada governança corporativa.
Tchau Petrobras (PETR4), olá BB Seguridade (BBSE3)
Segundo a Terra, a BB Seguridade mantém um perfil defensivo, elevada rentabilidade e forte capacidade de geração de caixa, além de apresentar exposição aos segmentos de seguros, previdência e capitalização.
A corretora destaca que a BrasilSeg continua registrando níveis favoráveis de sinistralidade, enquanto a BrasilPrev segue ampliando suas reservas.
Outro ponto citado é o elevado retorno sobre patrimônio (ROE), considerado um dos diferenciais da companhia dentro do setor. A Terra também vê espaço para crescimento das receitas recorrentes por meio da expansão dos negócios de seguros e previdência.
A ação apresenta preço-alvo de R$ 43 para os próximos 12 meses, dividend yield estimado em 11,75% e payout atual de 79%, segundo o relatório.
Sobre a Petrobras, a Terra destaca os fortes resultados apresentados no segundo trimestre de 2026, impulsionados pelo aumento da produção, preços mais favoráveis do petróleo e desempenho robusto do refino. O lucro líquido alcançou R$ 52,4 bilhões, enquanto a companhia aprovou R$ 17,4 bilhões em dividendos e juros sobre capital próprio referentes ao período.
No entanto, apesar da forte geração de caixa e das perspectivas ligadas à expansão da produção no pré-sal, a companhia segue exposta a riscos relacionados à volatilidade dos preços do petróleo, ao cenário político e à política de preços dos combustíveis.

itens.titulo: Nvidia stock hits record high after Foxconn Q3 2026 revenue surge
itens.descricao: Nvidia stock hits record high after Foxconn Q3 2026 revenue surge Yahoo Finance
trechos: Nvidia stock rose 2.1% to $238.90 on Monday, surpassing its previous all-time closing high of $235.74, reached in May.
The company's market capitalization stands at $5.6 trillion.
Foxconn, formally known as Hon Hai Precision Industry, reported September-quarter revenue of 3.03 trillion New Taiwan dollars ($95.48 billion), up 47% from the same period a year earlier.

Nvidia stock had been trading near its lowest forward earnings multiple in more than a decade, even as revenue and net income were each projected to grow by roughly 90% or more in its current fiscal year.
At Monday's close, Nvidia trades at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 17.1 times, according to Barron's, citing FactSet.

Separately, Nvidia authorized a $150 billion increase to its share repurchase program last week, bringing the total remaining buyback authorization to $235 billion — the largest such authorization increase in history, the company said.
The company expects to complete the total remaining program through fiscal year 2028.
Analysts covering Nvidia have set a consensus price target of $334.45 on the shares, according to Barron's, citing FactSet.

itens.titulo: Mysten Labs Announces Verifiable Agent Arbiter in Collaboration with Google Cloud
itens.descricao: Mysten Labs Announces Verifiable Agent Arbiter in Collaboration with Google Cloud PR Newswire
itens.texto:
Verifiable Agent Arbiter keeps agent records private inside the enterprise while anchoring proof of their integrity to Sui and Walrus, giving counterparties, auditors, and regulators a credibly neutral record of agent actions.
PALO ALTO, Calif., Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mysten Labs, in collaboration with Google Cloud, today announced Verifiable Agent Arbiter (VAA), an evidence layer being co-developed to enable enterprises to prove their AI agents acted within the authority they were granted. As agents move to executing transactions, negotiating with other agents, and acting across company boundaries, VAA gives enterprises a record of that activity that can be verified independently of the platform that produced it.
Today's organizations want to move agents into production but are held back by the absence of a record that a counterparty, auditor, or regulator can trust. VAA is designed to provide that record and help companies comply with upcoming regulatory requirements, including the EU AI Act, which from 2027 will introduce penalties of up to €15 million or 3% of global annual turnover for logging failures.
VAA separates the record of an agent's activity from the proof of its integrity. Detailed telemetry, including prompts, model outputs, tool calls, and policy decisions, remains private in customer-controlled Google Cloud Storage. Cryptographic proofs of that record will be stored on Walrus, the data platform built for the demands of AI, and coordinated on Sui, a Layer 1 blockchain.
Key Enterprise Capabilities
"AI agents are starting to make decisions with financial and legal consequences, and we need systems to ensure they cannot exceed their authority. This requires evidence any counterparty can verify," said Evan Cheng, Co-Founder and CEO of Mysten Labs. "Verifiable Agent Arbiter brings together records of what an agent was permitted to do, what it did, and what resulted, and anchors proof to Sui and Walrus. We've engineered these networks to be neutral, resilient, and to hold up at the speed and scale of autonomous agents. With Google Cloud we are putting them to work inside enterprise workflows."
Initial deployments with enterprise customers are planned ahead of broader availability. For more information or to register interest, contact [email protected].
Media contact
Mysten Labs: [email protected]
About Mysten Labs
Mysten Labs is a team of leading technological experts in distributed systems, programming languages and cryptography. Founded by the core team behind Meta's first stablecoin initiative, Mysten Labs is the original contributor to Sui, the Layer-1 blockchain where money moves as freely as messages, and to Walrus, the data platform built for the demands of AI. Users can learn more at mystenlabs.com.

itens.titulo: Ethereum Layer 2 Blast Is Shutting Down: What Happens to Your Coins?
itens.descricao: Ethereum Layer 2 Blast Is Shutting Down: What Happens to Your Coins? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Blast's monthly revenue collapsed from $3.5 million at peak to just $1,793 in September, forcing the Ethereum layer 2 network into a full shutdown.
- ETH deposited on Blast remains safe in Ethereum's bridge contract, but withdrawing via the app before October 26 is the easiest option.
- The BLAST token carries the biggest risk, already down 99% from its 2024 peak with its value entirely tied to the dying network.
(Sponsor) Blast, an Ethereum (CRYPTO:ETH) layer 2 network that attracted $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 launch, is shutting down.
On October 2, 2026, the team announced that the cost of running the network exceeds its earnings and that there's no viable solution to fix this.
Users will have until October 26 to withdraw their funds through the network's regular app.
In September, the network brought in just $1,793, a dramatic drop from its peak earnings of approximately $3.5 million in one of its best months.
As of October 6, total deposits plummeted to about $24 million, a staggering 99% drop from the 2024 peak, and the BLAST (CRYPTO:BLAST) token tumbled nearly 19% after the announcement.

itens.titulo: Tech Mahindra Expands Agentic AI Readiness with Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise
itens.descricao: Tech Mahindra Expands Agentic AI Readiness with Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise PR Newswire
itens.texto:
Scales Gemini Enterprise Readiness Across 12,500+ Associates with Google Cloud
PUNE, India, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tech Mahindra (NSE: TECHM), a leading provider of AI-powered digital transformation and technology consulting solutions to enterprises across industries, announced an expansion of its agentic AI readiness through partnership with Google Cloud. The partnership aims at scaling hands-on capabilities of Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise across Tech Mahindra's global workforce to support growing enterprise demand for production-ready AI.
Tech Mahindra's scaled readiness combines trained and certified talent with reusable industry solutions, production deployment experience, and a growing portfolio of agentic AI solutions and agents. Its expanding portfolio includes industry-specific solutions available through Google Cloud Marketplace, enabling customers accelerate adoption of enterprise AI with capabilities designed for real-world business environments. This combination is designed to help customers move from AI experimentation to implementation and adoption.
A key element of this expansion is 'Build with Gemini', a Google Cloud hands-on workshop that Tech Mahindra is rolling out to more than 12,500 associates worldwide. Designed as an immersive event, 'Build with Gemini' empowers participants learn to create, secure, and govern AI agents using Gemini Enterprise tools and solutions including Agent Runtime, Agent Gateway, and Model Armor. Attendees develop practical skills that can be applied directly into client engagements, complementing Tech Mahindra's broader 'AI Delivered Right' strategy, which focuses on translating AI innovation into responsible, secure, and measurable enterprise outcomes.
Associates completing the 'Build with Gemini' workshop earn a Google Cloud Skill Badge, further strengthening the talent base supporting Tech Mahindra's delivery capabilities. This builds on Tech Mahindra's experience deploying Gemini Enterprise in complex enterprise environments and developing industry-specific agentic AI solutions across telecommunications, financial services, manufacturing, retail, and other sectors.
Pramod Panda, Chief Learning Officer, Tech Mahindra, said, "Enterprise AI will scale only when organizations can combine technology innovation with the talent and delivery capability required to put it into production. Together with Google Cloud, we are building that capability by combining hands-on Gemini Enterprise expertise with industry solutions, agents, and real-world deployment experience. This strengthens our ability to help clients move faster from AI ambition to measurable outcomes, consistent with our AI Delivered Right approach."
Kelly Rogan, Vice President, Global System Integrators Partnerships, Google Cloud, said, "Enterprises are shifting rapidly from AI experimentation to deployment, where domain expertise and robust engineering matter most. By scaling Gemini Enterprise, Tech Mahindra equips its global teams to build, deploy, and govern agentic AI solutions. Together, we are helping joint customers accelerate innovation and drive business value with Google Cloud."
The expansion reinforces Tech Mahindra's focus on collaborating with Google Cloud to help enterprises build the skills, solutions, and delivery capacity required to move agentic AI from experimentation to production at scale.
SOURCE Tech Mahindra
